_meta.description: Churches/towns where CSM has planted congregations.

fields.id: URL slug — auto-generated from name (lowercased, non-alphanumerics → dashes)
fields.name: Town/church name (e.g. 'Chickaballapur')
fields.start_date: When the church was planted (free-form string)
fields.photo: Local path /images/churches/{id}.jpg — set from the local file system, never from the sheet
fields.latitude: Decimal latitude in degrees (null if unknown)
fields.longitude: Decimal longitude in degrees (null if unknown)
fields.raising_support: true when this congregation is raising funds to build a permanent church building

churches.name: Chickaballapur
churches.description: We have two services at our main church building. The distance is too far to travel for some Christians so we have started two more services in nearby villages. One is in a rented building and another in someone's home. We're planning to build a church in each village.

churches.name: Chintamani
churches.description: We are currently meeting in someone's home. We've purchased land and are planning to build a church building on it.

churches.name: Gowribindanur
churches.description: We have a church building in Gowribindanur but the distance is too far for some Christians. We have a weekly service at a nearby village in someone's home and plan to build a church building as they've outgrown the home.

churches.name: Kodigenhalli
churches.description: We are currently meeting in a rented building. We have purchased land and plan to build a church building on it.

churches.name: Sevamandir
churches.description: We are meeting in a rented classroom. We are planning to buy land and build a church building.
